'''Sokar volcano''' was an active [[Volcano/Legends|volcano]] on [[Zerist]], one of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Obri]] in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]]. The [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kainnan]] was located at its base, to obtain warmth and energy from the volcano. The government of Zerist usually predicted the eruptions of Sokar in time and evacuated the population of the city for the periods of volcanic activity.<ref name="Eruption" />
